attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the DNS resolver for the shared 10.100.215.0/24 network: it answers inventory.internal with node2's address (10.100.215.11) via a system static-host-mapping consumed by pdns-recursor, and forwards all other queries upstream to 1.1.1.1/9.9.9.9. node2 and node3 (RHEL7) were reconfigured via nmcli (ipv4.dns=10.100.215.10, ipv4.ignore-auto-dns=yes) to resolve exclusively through node1. Verified inventory.internal and external resolution work end-to-end from node2 and node3. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes: captured pre-restart boot_id and service/data health, issued native reboot, confirmed connection drop, polled until exec access returned, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified DNS config/resolution health post-restart before moving to the next node.
